headline: Ambarella Beats Q3 EPS Expectations but Misses Revenue Estimates
summary: Ambarella reported third-quarter financial results that topped analyst estimates for earnings per share. However, the company's revenue fell short of consensus forecasts.
why: Ambarella designs low-power video processing and computer vision semiconductors.

impacts.name: Ambarella, Inc.
impacts.why: Ambarella reported Q3 results with EPS exceeding expectations while revenue missed.
